# HyperTune Garage - Full Automotive Technical Knowledge Base & Service Specifications

> HyperTune Garage is Pakistan's premier specialized automotive workshop, computerized diagnostics studio, Paint Protection Film (PPF) application center, and European/Japanese luxury car care facility located in Islamabad and Rawalpindi.

## Business Profile & Metadata

- **Name:** HyperTune Garage
- **Industry:** Automotive Repair, Car Detailing, Paint Protection Film (PPF), German Vehicle Diagnostics, Body Modification

## Detailed Service Catalog

### 1. Paint Protection Film (PPF) Installation
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/paint-protection-film-ppf
- **Description:** High-grade optical TPU (Thermoplastic Polyurethane) film application offering scratch self-healing, stain resistance, and UV rejection.
- **Technology:** Computer-aided design (CAD) plotter pre-cut film to ensure 100% blade-free installation on vehicle paintwork.
- **Warranty:** 5 to 10 Year Written Warranty against bubbling, cracking, and yellowing.
- **Packages:**
  - Front Package (Bumper, Hood, Fenders, Side Mirrors, Headlights)
  - Full Vehicle Wrap (Gloss or Stealth Satin Matte Finish)
  - Interior Screen & Piano Black Trim Protection

### 2. PPS Paint Protection System & 9H Ceramic Coating
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/pps-paint-protection-system
- **Description:** Multi-layer liquid quartz glass and graphene ceramic coating forming a permanent chemical bond with factory clear coat.
- **Features:** 9H pencil hardness, 110-degree water contact angle (super-hydrophobic), high gloss mirror reflection, and chemical protection (pH 2 - pH 12).
- **Warranty:** 2 to 5 Year Warranty with complimentary periodic inspection.

### 3. German & Luxury Vehicle Diagnostics
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/computer-diagnostics-scanning
- **OEM Diagnostic Systems:**
  - BMW ISTA+ & INPA
  - Mercedes-Benz XENTRY & DAS
  - Audi / Porsche / VW VAG ODIS
  - Toyota / Lexus Techstream
- **Capabilities:** ECU coding, transmission adaptation, active sensor testing, electronic module programming, and key synchronization.

### 4. Engine & Mechanical Overhauls
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/engine-services
- **Description:** Complete rebuilds of petrol, turbo, and diesel engines to factory torque specs with OEM pistons, rings, bearings, and gaskets.
- **Precision Equipment:** Computerized cylinder honing, micrometer crank inspection, pressure-tested cylinder heads.

### 5. Hybrid & EV Battery Diagnostics & Reconditioning
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/hybrid-ev-battery-services
- **Vehicles Serviced:** Toyota Prius, Aqua, Axio, Fielder, Corolla Cross, Honda Vezel, Fit, Grace, Hyundai, Kia Hybrids.
- **Services:** Computerized individual cell capacity testing, balancing, cooling fan cleaning, busbar corrosion removal, and cell replacement.

### 6. Brakes, Suspension & 3D Wheel Alignment
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/brakes-suspension-alignment
- **Features:** High-definition 3D camera wheel alignment, brake disc skim lathe machining, polyurethane and OEM rubber bushing overhaul.

### 7. Transmission & Gearbox Overhaul
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/transmission-gearbox-services
- **Gearbox Types:** CVT, Dual Clutch Transmission (DSG/DCT), Traditional Torque Converter, and Manual Gearboxes.
- **Services:** Complete solenoid testing, valve body repair, mechatronics programming, and full synthetic fluid flushing.

### 8. Custom Body Kits & Aerodynamics
- **URL:** https://hypertunegarage.pk/services/body-kit-custom-modification
- **Modifications:** FRP and ABS body kits, carbon fiber front splitters, rear diffusers, ducktail spoilers, and custom sports exhaust systems.
